# The Indian Express

> Indian news publisher covering breaking news, analysis, explainers, opinion, sports, entertainment, business, and regional reporting.

The Indian Express is a major Indian news site with national, international, city, and topic-based coverage, plus premium journalism, e-paper access, multilingual editions, and exam-preparation resources through UPSC Essentials.

## Main News Sections
- [Home](https://indianexpress.com/): Front page with latest headlines across India, world, politics, business, sports, and entertainment.
- [India News](https://indianexpress.com/section/india/): National news coverage on politics, policy, crime, governance, and major developments across India.
- [World News](https://indianexpress.com/section/world/): International reporting on geopolitics, conflicts, diplomacy, and major global events.
- [Cities](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/): Aggregated city reporting from metros and regional bureaus across India.
- [Latest News](https://indianexpress.com/latest-news/): Reverse-chronological stream of recent stories, updates, and breaking developments.
- [Live Blog](https://indianexpress.com/section/live-blog/): Live updates for elections, sports, weather, conflicts, and other fast-moving events.

## Politics, Policy & Public Affairs
- [Political Pulse](https://indianexpress.com/section/political-pulse/): Political reporting, election analysis, party strategy, and government developments.
- [Explained](https://indianexpress.com/section/explained/): Context-rich explainers unpacking current affairs, policy, law, science, and global events.
- [Opinion](https://indianexpress.com/section/opinion/): Editorials, columns, and expert commentary on politics, economy, society, and public policy.
- [Elections](https://indianexpress.com/elections/): Election news, campaign coverage, results, and constituency-level political reporting.
- [India News](https://indianexpress.com/section/india/): National affairs reporting with strong focus on governance, institutions, and public policy.

## Business, Economy & Technology
- [Business](https://indianexpress.com/section/business/): Business news covering markets, economy, companies, policy, and personal finance.
- [Technology](https://indianexpress.com/section/technology/): News and analysis on consumer tech, internet platforms, AI, devices, and digital policy.
- [Trending](https://indianexpress.com/section/trending/): Internet trends, viral stories, social media moments, and culture-driven web coverage.
- [Research](https://indianexpress.com/section/research/): Data-backed reporting and analytical pieces on policy, economy, and public issues.

## Sports Coverage
- [Sports News](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/): Broad sports coverage including cricket, football, tennis, Olympics, and athlete profiles.
- [Cricket](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/cricket/): Match coverage, analysis, team news, interviews, and tournament updates.
- [IPL](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/ipl/): Indian Premier League news, fixtures, live updates, and team-specific reporting.
- [Football](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/football/): Football news, match reports, transfer developments, and tournament coverage.
- [Tennis](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/tennis/): Grand Slam reporting, player news, results, and analysis.
- [Badminton](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/badminton/): Tournament updates, player profiles, and Indian badminton coverage.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://indianexpress.com/section/entertainment/): Film, television, OTT, celebrity, and pop-culture news and features.
- [Bollywood](https://indianexpress.com/section/entertainment/bollywood/): Hindi film industry news, interviews, reviews, and celebrity coverage.
- [Hollywood](https://indianexpress.com/section/entertainment/hollywood/): International film and television news, reviews, and celebrity updates.
- [Movie Reviews](https://indianexpress.com/section/entertainment/movie-review/): Reviews of Hindi, regional, and international film releases.
- [Web Series Reviews](https://indianexpress.com/section/entertainment/web-series-review/): Reviews and recommendations for streaming series across platforms.
- [Lifestyle](https://indianexpress.com/section/lifestyle/): Coverage of health, food, fashion, relationships, and everyday living.

## Education, Jobs & UPSC
- [Education](https://indianexpress.com/section/education/): News on exams, admissions, board results, policy, and higher education.
- [Jobs](https://indianexpress.com/section/jobs/): Recruitment notifications, government jobs, eligibility details, and application updates.
- [UPSC Current Affairs](https://indianexpress.com/section/upsc-current-affairs/): Current affairs coverage tailored for civil services aspirants.
- [UPSC Essentials](https://indianexpress.com/section/upsc-essentials/): Exam-oriented explainers, quizzes, and issue summaries for UPSC preparation.
- [Study Material](https://indianexpress.com/section/education/study-material/): Exam preparation resources, notes, and topic-based educational content.

## Health, Science & Environment
- [Health](https://indianexpress.com/section/lifestyle/health/): Reporting on medicine, wellness, public health, and disease-related developments.
- [Science](https://indianexpress.com/section/technology/science/): Science news, discoveries, space coverage, and research developments.
- [Environment](https://indianexpress.com/section/technology/environment/): Climate, conservation, pollution, and environmental policy reporting.
- [Parenting](https://indianexpress.com/section/lifestyle/parenting/): Family, child development, education, and parenting advice features.

## City Editions
- [Delhi](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/delhi/): Local news, civic issues, politics, crime, and public services in Delhi.
- [Mumbai](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/mumbai/): Mumbai city reporting on governance, transport, crime, and local developments.
- [Pune](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/pune/): Pune news covering civic affairs, education, infrastructure, and regional updates.
- [Chandigarh](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/chandigarh/): Chandigarh and surrounding region news, administration, and local politics.
- [Ahmedabad](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/ahmedabad/): Ahmedabad reporting on civic issues, politics, business, and community news.
- [Bangalore](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/bangalore/): Bengaluru coverage on urban governance, technology, traffic, and local affairs.
- [Kolkata](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/kolkata/): Kolkata news on politics, civic administration, culture, and regional developments.
- [Lucknow](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities/lucknow/): Lucknow and Uttar Pradesh reporting on governance, crime, and politics.

## Premium & Reader Products
- [Express Premium](https://indianexpress.com/section/premium/): Subscriber-focused journalism featuring deeper analysis, investigations, and exclusive stories.
- [Epaper](https://indianexpress.com/epaper/): Digital replica of the print newspaper for edition-based reading.
- [Mini](https://indianexpress.com/mini/): Short-form updates and compact reads designed for quick news consumption.
- [Photos](https://indianexpress.com/photos/): Photo galleries documenting news events, sports, entertainment, and public life.
- [Videos](https://indianexpress.com/videos/): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and event coverage.

## Language Editions
- [Tamil](https://tamil.indianexpress.com/): Tamil-language edition covering regional, national, and entertainment news.
- [Bengali](https://bengali.indianexpress.com/): Bengali-language edition with West Bengal, India, and world coverage.
- [Malayalam](https://malayalam.indianexpress.com/): Malayalam-language edition focused on Kerala, India, and global news.
- [Gujarati](https://gujarati.indianexpress.com/): Gujarati-language edition covering Gujarat, India, business, and sports news.
